# `drive.folder_add`

Register a Drive folder containing your own writing. Google Docs in its subfolders are included; folder shortcuts are never followed.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice drive-folder_add`
- **MCP tool:** `drive_folder_add` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder_id` | `str` | required | The operator-selected Drive folder id |

## Examples

```
operator-voice drive-folder_add --folder-id <id>
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
